name: Monkey Trug Revamped
summary:
Hop into the world of Monkey Trug Revamped, the revamped version of Monkey Trug!
Play, Experience, Adventure and most importantly.. Have fun!

Monkey Trug was a game made by me and other developers 2-3 years ago and the game got corrupted, so i decided to revamp it 2-3 years later.

Explore with or without your friends in Monkey Trug Revamped  in different maps as in horror, minigames, vibe area and for the nostalgia, the og Monkey Trug map!
